_comment: Single source of truth for the host unit-test lane (test/host).
Every committed test/main/test_*.c must appear in 'tests' (runs on the
host) or in 'excluded' with a reason (on-target only).
test/host/main/host_main.c and 'expected_cases' are generated from this
that they are up to date.
